suggested.hi: याम, पहर (रातका) | watch of the night (root याम)
suggested.en: watch (a three-hour division of the night)

reason: In बीति जात निसि जामा the word is याम (watch of the night), not the verb जमना.

suggested.hi: मान ले (आज्ञार्थ) | accept, obey (imperative, root मानना)

reason: In सपदि मानु मम बानी it is the imperative of मानना, 'accept my word'.

current: सपने में भी | even in dream
reason: No 'भी/even' in this line; Trijaṭā is reporting what she saw in her dream.
रूप बहु मंद: hideous forms; the sense 'bad, vile' is missing.
बहसि बर धारा refers to the sword's edge; that sense is missing.

suggested.hi: बनाव, सजावट, शृंगार | adornment, finery (संज्ञा, root बनाव)

reason: किएँ बनावा = adorned, dressed in finery; here a noun, not 'made'.
The English 'having consoled' does not fit कहहु निज कथा बुझाई ('tell your story clearly').
गुन ग्राम = host of virtues; the entry for ग्रामा (8.cau1) already has समूह, ग्राम lacks it.
सबहीं बिधि हीना = lowly in every way; 'सब ने' (agentive) does not fit.

suggested.hi: लगाये हुए, टिकाये हुए (नयन दिएँ) | having fixed (the eyes on)

reason: निज पद नयन दिएँ = with eyes fixed on her own feet; 'by giving' misleads.

current: सेवा करके | serving (पूर्वकालिक क्रिया, root सेना)
reason: Root should be सेवना (to serve), not सेना.
